assessment: All eight catalogues completed under the new prospectively increased caps. The two substantive backward-control proofs combine the addition defining equations and use the incidence unique-line axiom respectively. The arithmetic input contains no induction schema; the incidence proof is a symbolic consequence of its declared axiom, not a new geometric theorem.

GCTS proved only the two calibration cases and hit its wall on all six substantive targets. The backward control proved the calibrations plus arith-right-one and incidence-distinct-lines-common-points, and exhausted the other four finite bounded catalogues. This configuration provides no GCTS search-advantage evidence.

The table reports every case and both lanes, including incomplete construction, finite-catalogue exhaustion and resource cutoffs. A smaller UNKNOWN node count or time is not a search win. A finite NOT_DERIVABLE control result is limited to the complete reviewed catalogue and declared line bound, not unrestricted mathematical unprovability.

Both lanes share the W catalogue. Cache reclamation and aggregate degree bookkeeping change representation and resource costs; the same complete non-cost catalogue and candidate identities are retained. This cohort does not isolate these changes with equal-cost cache or aggregate ablations, and its changed caps/work units do not establish a V-to-W speed ratio.

Checked proof ancestry records only actual dependency-reachable named axioms. Several names in the original theory may be unused or serve only padding. Used names do not establish a minimal axiom set, indispensability or a new theorem.

A GCTS-specific practical benefit still needs a prospectively declared marking/cluster contribution against a control with equal available lemmas and acquisition/invocation costs. The current engine uses complete base candidates and has no new learned policy or RL training.

These finite symbolic point rows do not provide unrestricted FOL/PA/Hilbert completeness, the Peano induction schema, or a fixed literal universal Wang palette. Whole-machine lowering and accepting-boundary equivalence remain open. No broad superiority or novel mathematics claim follows.
